subject: english
question:
Choose the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word in the given sentence.

The __melancholy__ song brought tears to my eyes.
solution:
The correct answer is “**Ecstasy**”.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• “**Melancholy**” refers to a feeling of deep sadness or gloom. (मनःस्ताप) 

 
 
• **Example**- Winning the lottery filled him with ecstasy.
 
 
 
• “**Ecstasy**” refers to an overwhelming feeling of happiness or joyful excitement. (अत्यंत आनंद) 
 
 
• **Example**- She sank into a state of deep melancholy after hearing the bad news.
 
 
 
• Hence, the option that is Opposite in meaning to the given word is ‘Ecstasy’.

Therefore, the correct answer is ‘**Option 2**’.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__ **

 
• ‘Let’s have a look at the meaning of the remaining options.’
 
• **Seclusion **refers to the state of being private and away from other people. (एकांत) 
 
• **Tremendousness **refers to the quality of being extremely good, large, or great. (प्रचंडता) 
 
• **Aesthetic **refers to a set of principles concerned with the nature and appreciation of beauty. (सौंदर्यशास्त्र)
